titles_en.title: Rabbit Story: No Love Zone Side Story

description:
Eun-Kyum, a short-eared rabbit, takes care of his two younger siblings and makes a living by growing carrots. Then one day, his younger siblings pick up a cat. However, upon closer inspection, he discovers that it is not a cat, but a baby tiger?! He tries to send the tiger back, but his siblings keep nagging him, so he ends up living with the tiger. However, when his siblings leave the house, the baby tiger transforms into a human! What's more, it is not a baby, but an adult tiger... Eun-Kyum, who is helpless against this tiger that attacks him every night, demanding that he give birth to a baby tiger, tries to chase Ji-Hyuk away every day. However, unlike his fellow rabbits who usually left Eun-Kyum alone because of his short ears, Ji-Hyuk begins to show a small rift in his heart as he pours all his affection into him. And it seems that Ji-Hyuk has a hidden past of his own...

A romance between Eun-Kyum the rabbit who tries to chase away Ji-Hyuk the tiger and the tiger who is obsessed with the rabbit! 

Who will be the winner between the two?

(Source: OrangeD, translated)
